result.summary: The T-1731 round itself is an empty commit. That is justified: the only red test is test_gate_timeout.test_flaky_rerun_kills_tree_on_timeout, which is out of scope and flaky under load. The substantive fix is T-1729's. It declares the 'triage' Jev site and passes site='triage', so jev.ask() no longer calls notify synchronously between run()'s claim and its launch. The commit message names the cause. The new test is sound: BOUNDARIES stores fields as a frozenset, so the set <= frozenset comparison works. I did not run the three acceptance modules; the commit message reports 387 passing.

comments.issue: The boundary is declared at import time, so it depends on the field list staying in sync with _jev_state. The new test covers this. The max_chars value reuses jev.DEFAULT_MAX_STATE_CHARS rather than a reviewed per-site limit.
